title: rest: `POST /data/OBJECT/ID/clone` with `overrides` plus other top-level keys silently drops the other keys
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Found in the os-dev-report of the #27500 + #27489 fold (on #27500) and escalated by the contract review of PR #27659, record `6503044025` (out of that fold's scope).

## What is wrong

The clone door accepts two body shapes: `{ "overrides": { … } }` and a bare field map. The choice is made by the presence of an `overrides` key alone (`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, the clone handler: `const nested = isFieldMap(body) && 'overrides' in body; const overrides = nested ? body.overrides : body;`). A body that carries `overrides` AND other top-level keys, for example `{ "overrides": { "name": "Copy" }, "status": "draft" }`, reads only `overrides`; `status` is dropped and the answer is a 201 success. The caller believes both values were applied. That is the same silent-drop class #27489 fixed for a non-object `overrides`, one shape over.

Re-check: after PR #27659 merges, the harness in `packages/rest/src/clone-overrides-refusal.test.ts` boots the door; POST the body above and read the clone's `status`.

## Expected

A body that carries `overrides` beside any other top-level key is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` in the route's nested envelope, naming the unexpected keys and the two accepted shapes, before `cloneData` runs. A narrowing: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, contract review before approval. Note for triage: an object with a real field named `overrides` cannot be cloned through the bare-map shape today either; whether that needs a word belongs to the same card.

Filed without `domain:*`; grading is triage's.
